RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 10

An all-woman panel selecting a woman over you — also a woman — tells you almost nothing about sex discrimination. Composition alone isn't evidence; it only becomes relevant if a pattern of outcomes points somewhere, and here it points nowhere. Raising it would weaken your credibility on the point that actually works for you.

That point is strong: on paper you hold a master's in educational leadership and five years of actual deputy-principal experience against "courses" and classroom years. That's a substantive qualifications gap requiring justification.

Press the real lever: send a written follow-up demanding the reasons you requested, citing any statutory deadline that applies. Silence after two weeks is itself the irregularity worth pursuing.
